target_reference_entry:
[240] Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai Zhang,
and Sanglu Lu. Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing
sub-mm level vibration. Proceedings of ACM IMWUT (UbiComp), 2020.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在介绍将各种传感器转化为侧信道麦克风的相关工作时，将目标论文作为非声学硬件（通信设备）用于语音窃听的示例之一，属于普通的相关工作罗列，未单独描述或评价目标论文的具体贡献。

evidences.evidence_quote: Recent research indicates that non-acoustic hardware, such as motion sensors [153, 32, 34, 39, 209, 80], actuators [151, 192, 138], communication devices [255, 240, 271, 133, 254], storage devices [125], radars [52, 75, 268, 238, 288, 279, 54], cameras [63, 141], and instruments [169, 168, 286, 195], can create a side channel to eavesdrop the speech generated by humans or loudspeakers.
evidences.evidence_context: The pervasive use of speech communication devices amplifies the potential threats of speech eavesdropping, i.e., secretly listening to private speech without the speaker's consent or awareness. Due to the emergence of smart devices, speech eavesdropping can occur in broader scenarios than overhearing through walls. Recent research indicates that non-acoustic hardware, such as motion sensors [153, 32, 34, 39, 209, 80], actuators [151, 192, 138], communication devices [255, 240, 271, 133, 254], storage devices [125], radars [52, 75, 268, 238, 288, 279, 54], cameras [63, 141], and instruments [169, 168, 286, 195], can create a side channel to eavesdrop the speech generated by humans or loudspeakers.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 目标论文[240]被包含在一组引用列表中，作为通信设备用于侧信道窃听的示例之一。引用语句仅概括性地说明非声学硬件可窃听语音，未单独提及目标论文的亚毫米级能力或穿墙特性，属于普通的相关工作罗列，不满足任何模板的正面证据要求。因此排除。
